subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

It is a fact that Pradip’s bigotry results out of his lack of __appreciation__ for another group's activities, and disregard of others’ belief systems.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Disregard**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The bracketed word **"appreciation"** means recognition and enjoyment of the good qualities of someone or something. (प्रशंसा)

 
 
• **Example: **She smiled, showing her appreciation for the beautifully prepared meal.
 
 
 
• The antonym** "disregard" **means to pay no attention to; ignore. (उपेक्षा)
 
 
• **Example: **The council's disregard for the safety concerns of residents was criticized.
 
 
 
• As we can see, **'Disregard' **is the antonym of **'Appreciation'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is- **Disregard**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"System"**, refers to a set of things working together as parts of a mechanism or an interconnecting network. (प्रणाली)
 
• Option 3, **"Lack"**, means to be without or to not have enough of something. (कमी)
 
• Option 4, **"Bigotry"**, represents intolerance towards those who hold different opinions from oneself. (कट्टरता)
